'''Norris Prang''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served as a wing commander in [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn's]] army.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], he delivered the report of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] supposed death to Shadowspawn. Thinking that Shadowspawn would be pleased at the enemy's death, Prang was surprised when Shadowspawn was not delighted and ordered him to come up with a plan to capture Skywalker alive.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
